The '''Windswept Lakes''' were more than a dozen bodies of [[water]] that formed at the intersection between the [[Merchant Mounds]] of the [[city]] of [[Riar]] and the surrounding [[swamp]]s. The [[Merchant-Baron's mansion]] was located on the shore of the largest lake, about forty-five [[Standard minute|minutes]] from [[Merchant Mound Three]].<ref name="GoD" />
